dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout-pa.title: Dolomites Sella Ronda Overnight Scout · part 1
dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout-pa.slogan: Chur eastbound to Campolongo Pass · one way, about 548 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Chur eastbound gate
waypoints.advice: Chur eastbound is where the day begins. Next is Ofenpass approach, climbing 1556 m.

waypoints.name: Ofenpass approach
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2149 m here. The road climbs 1556 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Pordoi Pass.

waypoints.name: Pordoi Pass
waypoints.advice: 2239 m, and the road stops climbing. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Campolongo Pass, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Campolongo Pass
waypoints.advice: Campolongo Pass closes the day. You lose 364 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 8 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind.

sections.advice: Chur eastbound gate → Ofenpass approach climbs about 1556 m in 78 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Ofenpass approach → Pordoi Pass is 147 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Pordoi Pass → Campolongo Pass is 7 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Height already gained and held. The road stays near 2239 m for 347 km instead of surrendering it to the next valley — exposed ground: wind matters more here than gradient. Nothing blocks it.

scenicChapters.title: Great Dolomites Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2239 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout-pa.story: 548 km from Chur to Corvara in Badia, about 8 h 41 of riding. The climbs: Ofenpass approach and Pordoi Pass. It tops out at 2,239 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 62 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-saline-royale-d-arc-et-senans-bou.story: A 262 km round trip from Arc-et-Senans - roughly 4 h 31 in the saddle. On the way it passes Le Grand Lac de Clairvaux, Bourg and back through Le Grand Lac de Clairvaux. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
